name: mongoDBRefNew
description: Creates a MongoDB DBRef, a reference from one document to a document in another collection, identified by that collection's name and the referenced document's `_id`.

params.name: collectionName
params.description: Name of the collection that holds the referenced document.

params.name: objectId
params.description: The `_id` of the referenced document, for example an ObjectId created with mongoObjectIdNew.

params.name: db
params.description: Name of the database that holds the referenced collection.
